story.personality: Energetic, exacting, and quick to praise brave decisions.
story.theme: Timing, momentum, and controlled electrical circuits
story.preBattleMessage: Every strong team finds its rhythm under pressure. Show me yours!
story.battleLine: Keep moving. Hesitation gives the current somewhere to strike!
story.postBattleMessage: You kept your rhythm even when the current changed. The Volt Badge belongs with you.
story.localStoryHook: Volt City's instruments are picking up an unfamiliar pulse from beyond the Forest.

supportingPrelude.name: Professor Lumen
supportingPrelude.text: Spark studies the same strange habitat pulse we detected in the Forest. Your battle may help calibrate the signal.

story.personality: Calm and observant, with a talent for turning pressure into opportunity.
story.theme: Adaptation, patience, and shifting harbor currents
story.preBattleMessage: A fixed plan sinks quickly. Let me see how well you adapt.
story.battleLine: Read the current, then choose your moment.
story.postBattleMessage: You changed course without losing sight of your team. Accept the Aqua Badge.
story.localStoryHook: Aqua Harbor's tides have begun changing without wind or warning.

story.personality: Passionate and direct, but disciplined beneath the heat.
story.preBattleMessage: Power without control burns out fast. Bring me a flame that lasts!
story.battleLine: Stand firm. The hottest moment reveals a Trainer's resolve!
story.postBattleMessage: That was conviction, not recklessness. Carry the Blaze Badge with pride.
story.localStoryHook: Volcanic sensors record heat waves moving against the natural vents.

supportingPrelude.name: Ranger Sol
supportingPrelude.text: The vents are stable, but wild Pokémon keep fleeing the upper trail. Flint has been watching the pattern too.

story.personality: Patient, protective, and attentive to every small change in nature.
story.theme: Growth, endurance, and the balance of the living forest
story.preBattleMessage: Strength grows quietly before it is seen. Show me what your journey has nurtured.
story.battleLine: A rooted team can weather any sudden change.
story.postBattleMessage: Your bonds have taken root. The Forest Badge marks how far they can still grow.
story.localStoryHook: The oldest trees are responding to a rhythm that does not belong to the seasons.

story.leaderTitle: Zephyr, Rider of the High Wind
story.personality: Free-spirited and daring, yet sharply aware of every change in the sky.
story.preBattleMessage: Up here, every choice carries farther. Let's see if you can keep pace!
story.battleLine: The wind changed. Did you notice before I did?
story.postBattleMessage: You found your footing where the air turns thin. The Storm Badge is yours.
story.localStoryHook: Storm Peak's winds now circle a fixed point above the Mountain.

supportingPrelude.name: Rhea Vale
supportingPrelude.text: I followed the signal this far, but Zephyr reads these winds better than either of us. Win, and ask what he saw.

story.leaderTitle: Garnet, Keeper of the Deep Strata
story.personality: Steady, practical, and almost impossible to unsettle.
story.theme: Foundation, resilience, and the memory held in stone
story.preBattleMessage: A strong foundation is proven by what it survives. Test yours against mine.
story.battleLine: Pressure does not break a prepared team. It reveals it.
story.postBattleMessage: Your team held together under real weight. Take the Rock Badge.
story.localStoryHook: New fractures in Garnet Ridge point toward the same distant source as the habitat pulse.

story.personality: Quiet, perceptive, and more interested in intent than appearances.
story.preBattleMessage: Your choices leave an echo before your Pokémon move. I wonder what yours will reveal.
story.battleLine: Power is loud. Intent is clearer.
story.postBattleMessage: You trusted your team beyond what you could predict. The Psychic Badge recognizes that clarity.
story.localStoryHook: Moonveil records connect the Mountain signal to warnings preserved near the Graveyard.

supportingPrelude.name: Archivist Mira
supportingPrelude.text: Lunara recognized the pattern in our oldest records. Her Gym may be the last place to test your focus before the Graveyard clue.

story.leaderTitle: Glacius, Sentinel of the Still North
story.personality: Composed and demanding, with deep respect for Trainers who endure.
story.theme: Precision, patience, and resolve under extreme conditions
story.preBattleMessage: The final badge is not won by rushing. Hold your purpose when everything turns cold.
story.postBattleMessage: Your resolve did not fracture. The Ice Badge completes your road to the League.
story.localStoryHook: Cold light over Glacier Bay pulses in time with the Mountain and Graveyard signals.
